platform.en: In 2024, which was the most regularly used social media platform in the world?
platform.zh: 在2024年，世界上使用最频繁的社交媒体平台是什么？

platform.en: Governments and large corporations are also building systems and platforms based on AI.
platform.zh: 政府和大型企业也在构建基于AI的系统和平台。

platform.en: When my personal information is stored in a database, shared on platforms.
platform.zh: 当我的个人信息被存储在数据库中、在平台上共享。

platform.en: Cameras are everywhere. On platforms, in waiting areas, and at ticket gates.
platform.zh: 摄像头无处不在。月台上、候车区以及检票口。

platform.en: According to Dictionary.com, 6 7 became popular on TikTok and other social media platforms in 2024 and 2025.
platform.zh: 根据 Dictionary.com 的说法，“6 7”是在 2024 年和 2025 年间，在 TikTok 等社交媒体平台上流行起来的。

pleasant.en: The adjective stinky means foul smelling, while the adjective fragrant means pleasant smelling.
pleasant.zh: 形容词 stinky 意思是气味难闻的，而形容词 fragrant 意思是气味芳香宜人的。

pleasant.en: The noun liveability means the degree to which a place is pleasant to live in.
pleasant.zh: 名词“宜居性”指一个地方适合居住的舒适程度。

pleasant.en: So I would argue that wealth creation games are both more pleasant.
pleasant.zh: 所以我认为，财富创造游戏更加令人愉快。

pleasant.en: Gulf cities are also interested in liveability – the degree to which somewhere is a pleasant place to live.
pleasant.zh: 海湾城市也对宜居性感兴趣——某个地方作为一个宜居场所的舒适程度。

pleasant.en: I might think a perfume is stinky, an adjective meaning bad smelling, while Neil might find the same perfume fragrant, meaning pleasant smelling.
pleasant.zh: 我可能会觉得某款香水 stinky(难闻的)，而 Neil 可能会觉得同一款香水 fragrant(芳香宜人的)。

plenty.en: Despite these benefits, testing, and English testing in particular, has plenty of critics.
plenty.zh: 尽管有这些好处，测试，尤其是英语测试，也招来了大量的批评。

plenty.en: Yes, all right. We would say The Avenue, Coburg; Breese Street, Brunswick; Plenty Road, Bundoora.
plenty.zh: 是的，没错。我们会说：科堡的大道街；布伦瑞克的布里斯街；邦多拉的普伦蒂路。

plenty.en: Two or three minutes is plenty. Email the file to us at feedback at hiddenbrain.org.
plenty.zh: 两三分钟就足够了。把音频文件发送到 feedback at hiddenbrain.org。

plenty.en: This is known as the resource curse, or you might hear it called the paradox of plenty.
plenty.zh: 这就是所谓的资源诅咒，或者你可能会听到它被称为“丰饶的悖论”。

plenty.en: And in early 1692, life gave them plenty of reasons to feel that the devil was edging closer.
plenty.zh: 而在1692年初，生活给他们提供了充足的理由，让他们觉得魔鬼正在步步逼近。

planet.en: Human civilisation is thousands of years old but the planet itself is much older.
planet.zh: 人类文明有几千年的历史，但地球本身要古老得多。

planet.en: But it is anything but superfluous to the majority of people on this planet.
planet.zh: 但对这个星球上大多数人来说，手机绝非可有可无。

planet.en: Well, there's a lot of other planets, so yeah, I think there must be.
planet.zh: 嗯，有那么多其他的星球，所以是的，我想一定有。

planet.en: The difference between an asteroid and a planet mainly comes down to size.
planet.zh: 小行星和行星的区别主要在于大小。

planet.en: So, I’m wondering, do you do things that you think are good for the planet?
planet.zh: 那么，我在想，你会做一些你认为对地球有益的事情吗？

plural.en: The oldest surviving codices (which is the plural of codex) tend to be religious texts.
plural.zh: 现存最古老的手抄本（codices是codex的复数）往往是宗教文本。

plural.en: Grammatically it's odd. It's 'safe as houses' [plural] even though you're describing something singular.
plural.zh: 它的语法很奇怪。虽然你描述的是单数事物，但它用的却是复数形式的 'safe as houses'。

plural.en: The noun phenomenon, or phenomena in its plural form, refers to an observable fact or event that can be experienced through the senses.
plural.zh: 名词 phenomenon（现象，复数形式为 phenomena）指的是可以通过感官体验到的可观察的事实或事件。

player.en: All right, so you actually looked in a fairly systematic, empirical way at baseball players.
player.zh: 好的，所以你实际上以一种相当系统、实证的方式研究了棒球运动员。

player.en: He measures player's brainwaves before these important kicks and teaches them how to stay relaxed.
player.zh: 他测量了球员在这些重要射门前的脑电波，并教导他们如何保持放松。

player.en: To talk to some of these ball players? Camden is in the Atlantic League.
player.zh: 去和其中一些棒球运动员聊聊？卡姆登在大西洋联盟。

player.en: Or take Phil Taylor, one of the greatest darts players of all time.
player.zh: 或者以菲尔·泰勒（Phil Taylor）为例，他是史上最伟大的飞镖选手之一。

player.en: Here's Holly Bridge again, talking about how emotions can affect a player's game.
player.zh: 这里是Holly Bridge再次谈论情绪如何影响球员的比赛。

plantation.en: They had large plantations which produced crops such as tobacco, rice, and indigo.
plantation.zh: 他们拥有生产烟草、水稻和靛蓝等农作物的大型种植园。

plantation.en: These were very valuable things. These plantations relied heavily on African slaves.
plantation.zh: 这些是非常有价值的东西。这些种植园严重依赖非洲奴隶。

plantation.en: Here’s Albert Smith again. Mapping means that farmers have to actually provide the geolocations of their plantation.
plantation.zh: 下面再次请出 Albert Smith。测绘意味着农民实际上必须提供他们种植园的地理定位。

plantation.en: Look at the artifacts from plantations in the south that are in the collection of this college.
plantation.zh: 你去看看学院收藏里那些来自南方种植园的文物吧。

plantation.en: The people who survived the journey were sold at markets and forced to work on plantations or in mines.
plantation.zh: 在航行中幸存下来的人在市场上被贩卖，被迫在种植园或矿山劳作。

playground.en: Adventure playgrounds have lots of small dangers: hard pieces of wood, sharp metal, nails.
playground.zh: 冒险游乐场有很多小危险：硬木头、尖锐的金属、钉子。

playground.en: We know that adventure playgrounds started off after the Second World War, but in which country?
playground.zh: 我们知道冒险游乐场始于二战之后，但在哪个国家？

plague.en: Boris Yeltsin himself was deeply unpopular, and his government was plagued by corruption scandals.
plague.zh: Boris Yeltsin本人极不受欢迎，他的政府也饱受腐败丑闻的困扰。

plague.en: Everything from cancer, scurvy, the plague, respiratory ailments … it was used as an aphrodisiac.
plague.zh: 从癌症、坏血病、瘟疫、呼吸道疾病等应有尽有……它还曾被用作催情剂。

plague.en: But the road ahead is far from smooth. The organisation is still plagued by legal battles.
plague.zh: 但前方的道路远非一帆风顺。该组织仍然饱受法律诉讼的困扰。

plague.en: It was established by Executive Order on Donald Trump’s first day back in office and has been plagued by controversy ever since.
plague.zh: 它是在唐纳德·特朗普重返白宫的第一天通过行政令成立的，自此以后便争议不断。

plague.en: And small modular reactors, which I mentioned a few minutes ago, are another way to fight the issues that have plagued the construction of these large nuclear power plants.
plague.zh: 我几分钟前提到的小型模块化反应堆，是解决一直困扰这些大型核电站建设问题的另一种途径。

plastic.en: The island faces massive challenges from climate change, plastic pollution, and limited resources.
plastic.zh: 这座岛屿正面临着气候变化、塑料污染以及资源有限等巨大挑战。

plastic.en: Cars, planes, factories, shipping, plastics, electricity production, all of these things depend on oil.
plastic.zh: 汽车、飞机、工厂、航运、塑料、电力生产，所有这些都依赖于石油。

plastic.en: Many whale species are still endangered and all whales still face danger from ocean acidification and plastic pollution.
plastic.zh: 如今仍有许多鲸鱼物种处于濒危状态，而且所有鲸鱼仍然面临着海洋酸化和塑料污染的威胁。

plastic.en: They took out the spare shirt, but they were more interested in what the shirt was wrapped around: two sticks of plastic explosives, two bombs.
plastic.zh: 他们拿出了备用衬衫，但他们更关心的是衬衫包裹的东西：两根塑胶炸药，也就是两枚炸弹。

plastic.en: Evidence of our own civilisation, including plastics and man-made materials like concrete, is already being layered into the Earth's crust, and these are going to last a very long time.
plastic.zh: 我们自己文明的证据，包括塑料和混凝土等人造材料，已经被层层压入地壳中，这些东西将存在非常长的时间。

plain.en: But being a twin isn't always plain sailing – an idiom meaning easy and problem-free.
plain.zh: 但当双胞胎并不总是一帆风顺的——这是一个意为轻松且无问题（一帆风顺）的习语。

plain.en: To this, President Franklin D. Roosevelt had a plain answer: tough luck.
plain.zh: 对此，Franklin D. Roosevelt 总统给出了一个直截了当的回答：算你们倒霉。

plain.en: The dominant genre was the Western. Cowboys and sheriffs and open plains.
plain.zh: 当时最主流的电影类型是西部片：牛仔、警长，还有辽阔的平原。

plain.en: Across the Great Plains, some nations followed the migration of the bison.
plain.zh: 在大平原地区，一些民族跟随美洲野牛的迁徙路线生活。

plain.en: What are your tools of choice? Plain old ChatGPT, or something else?
plain.zh: 你首选的工具是什么？老式的 ChatGPT，还是别的什么？

plug.en: For example, countries around the world use different electrical plugs which would be better to standardise – but imagine the work involved!
plug.zh: 例如，世界各国使用不同的插头，如果能标准化会更好——但想象一下这涉及的工作量有多大！

plug.en: And, one more thing. Even once a data centre is built and ready to be turned on, you don't just plug it into the grid.
plug.zh: 还有一件事。即使数据中心建好并准备启用，你也不能直接把它插到电网里。

plug.en: A lot of the company founders didn't have a college degree, who didn't have a high school degree in a lot of instances, didn't come from money, were oftentimes just people who were ready to plug themselves into a system that would work for them.
plug.zh: 许多公司创始人沢有大学学位，在许多情况下连高中毕业证都沢有，也不是出身贵族，他们往往只是准备把自己插入一套能为他们工作的系统中。

plot.en: The plot, what actually happens in a Punch and Judy show, is famously violent.
plot.zh: 剧情——也就是 Punch and Judy 演出中实际发生的事情——以暴力闻名。

plot.en: And to this day, the plot has remained one of history’s great “what ifs”.
plot.zh: 直到今天，这场阴谋仍然是历史上最伟大的“如果”之一。

plot.en: Those directly involved in the July 20th plot included nationalists, democrats, aristocrats and communists.
plot.zh: 直接参与7月20日阴谋的人包括民族主义者、民主主义者、贵族和共产主义者。

plot.en: He continued to advise other kings and even plotted further campaigns against Rome.
plot.zh: 他继续为其他君王出谋划策，甚至策划着进一步反抗罗马的战役。

plot.en: Whether something changed, or he was silently plotting from a very young age, we do not know.
plot.zh: 是发生了什么改变，还是他从很小的时候起就在默默谋划，我们不得而知。

plausible.en: Unlike regular soldiers, Wagner’s troops operated with plausible deniability, allowing Russia to maintain a degree of separation from their actions.
plausible.zh: 与正规军不同，瓦格纳的部队以“合理否认”的方式行动，使俄罗斯能够与其行动保持一定程度的距离。

plausible.en: The North Koreans invented the botulism and sleeping pill excuse, thinking it might be more plausible than whatever did happen, but it had the opposite effect.
plausible.zh: 朝鲜方面编造出肉毒中毒和安眠药这个借口，以为这听起来会比实际发生的事更可信，但结果却适得其反。
始终保持着“可合理的否认性”。

pledge.en: He publicly pledged that he would fight in the arena as a gladiator if only Caligula recovered.
pledge.zh: 他公开承诺，只要 Caligula 康复，他就会作为角斗士在竞技场中战斗。

pledge.en: Henry took pledges of loyalty, brought Strongbow firmly under his authority, and sailed home the following year.
pledge.zh: Henry 接受了忠诚宣誓，将 Strongbow 牢牢置于自己的权威之下，并于次年启程回国。

pledge.en: Some oligarchs, like Roman Abramovich, struck deals with Putin, pledging their loyalty in exchange for keeping their fortunes.
pledge.zh: 一些寡头，比如罗曼·阿布拉莫维奇，与普京达成了协议，宣誓效忠以换取保留他们的财富。

pledge.en: They make pledges to crack down on Airbnb, but all that happens is the implementation of token "tourist taxes".
pledge.zh: 他们承诺严厉打击 Airbnb，但实际发生的却只是实施了象征性的“旅游税”。

pledge.en: These knights were required to take an oath of poverty, pledging to hand over all of their material possessions to the order.
pledge.zh: 这些骑士被要求发誓过贫困生活，承诺将他们所有的物质财产上交给修会。

plead.en: They wanted him to plead "not guilty by reason of insanity."
plead.zh: 他们希望他以“精神失常导致无罪”进行抗辩。

plead.en: On January 22, 1998, Ted Kaczynski pleaded guilty to all charges.
plead.zh: 1998 年 1 月 22 日，泰德·卡钦斯基对所有指控表示认罪。

plead.en: Otto’s parents, Fred and Cindy Warmbier, spoke publicly, pleading for their son's release, and trying everything they could think of to bring him home.
plead.zh: 奥托的父母弗雷德(Fred)和辛迪·瓦姆比尔(Cindy Warmbier)公开发声，恳求释放他们的儿子，想尽一切办法要把他带回家。

plateau.en: Some markets may see corrections. Others may plateau, or even continue to rise.
plateau.zh: 一些市场可能会看到调整。其他市场可能会趋于平稳，甚至继续上涨。

plateau.en: And then the past eight years have been a bit more stagnant, a bit more of a plateau.
plateau.zh: 但在过去的八年里，情况变得有些停滞不前，进入了一个平台期。

plateau.en: It was not linear. I had really fast improvement at the beginning, but then I hit a learning plateau.
plateau.zh: 它并不是线性的。我在刚开始时进步神速，但随后我遭遇了学习平台期。

plateau.en: And I think it's, I wonder, this is more just like an open thought, but like, I wonder how long like more successful people stay in that next plateau.
plateau.zh: 我在想，这其实只是一个开放式的想法，我在想那些更成功的人会在下一个平台期停留多久。

plea.en: In the end, he avoided a potentially lengthy and highly publicised trial by accepting a plea bargain.
plea.zh: 最后，他通过接受认罪协议，避免了一场可能旷日持久且备受瞩目的审判。

plutocrat.en: In part two, we are going to learn about the curious case of the man who went to Eton, the most exclusive private school in Britain, studying alongside princes and plutocrats, but was arrested on the charge of attempting a military coup in Equatorial Guinea.
plutocrat.zh: 在第二集中，我们将了解一个离奇的案件：一个曾在英国最顶尖的私立学校伊顿公学与王子和富豪们一同求学的男子，却因企图在赤道几内亚发动军事政变而被捕。

plunge.en: The invasion, which was widely seen as an attempt to reassert Russia’s influence and challenge NATO’s expansion, has plunged relations between Russia and the West to their lowest point since the Cold War.
plunge.zh: 这场入侵被普遍视为重塑俄罗斯影响力并挑战北约扩张的企图，它将俄乌以及俄罗斯与西方国家的关系降到了冷战以来的最低点。

plunge.en: And in late 2006 early 2007-- as prices began their plunge and alarm was spreading across mortgage-backed securities desks all over Wall Street-- the people on Wall Street, like Mike Francis, started backing away from some of the riskiest mortgages that they would accept.
plunge.zh: 在2006年底到2007年初——随着价格开始暴跌，恐慌情绪开始在整个华尔街的抵押贷款支持证券交易台蔓延——华尔街的人，比如迈克·弗朗西斯，开始从他们原本愿意接受的一些风险最高的抵押贷款中抽身。

plentiful.en: No matter how plentiful and cheap something might be on Earth, in space it suddenly becomes very expensive.
plentiful.zh: 无论某种东西在地球上多么充裕、多么便宜，到了太空中它突然就变得极为昂贵。

plaster.en: And indeed, when Keir Starmer gave his first speech after the announcement of the election, he stood in front of a podium with one word plastered in big capital letters: Change.
plaster.zh: 事实上，当 Keir Starmer 在宣布大选后发表第一次演讲时，他站在一个印有大写字母“CHANGE”（改变）的讲台前。
